Every service has a specific job in your customer journey. Open any service to see exactly what’s included.

tabs.tab_title: Can I pick only certain services?
tabs.tab_content: Every partnership is built from the services your plan needs, so you won’t pay for things that don’t move your business. What we don’t do is sell services one at a time, because marketing works as a system.

tabs.tab_title: How do you decide which services my plan includes?
tabs.tab_content: On your strategy call and in your roadmap, we score your business across all four stages. Your plan starts with the weakest stage, then builds out as results come in.

tabs.tab_title: Why are some services in more than one stage?
tabs.tab_content: Because they do more than one job. Social Media, for example, helps people discover you, turns followers into leads and keeps customers engaged. Each service page shows what it does at each stage.

tabs.tab_title: Do I own my accounts and assets?
tabs.tab_content: [CONFIRM] Yes. Your website, ad accounts, social profiles, content and data belong to your business.

tabs.tab_title: Can I learn to do this myself instead?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. The BeFirst Community gives you the course, Blueprint and webinars for every stage for $88/month, and coaching is available from $500/month.
